milestone: local watcher operator setup and signed report verification

coverage: Invoked the documented Ed25519 key generator and kept its private seed in memory until writing a mode-0600 temporary .env.
Started the actual payment watcher handler with that temporary operator configuration.
Served one synthetic incoming Monero transfer from a local wallet-RPC fixture.
Pinned the generated public key and passed the signed v2 report through production checkPayment until the synthetic state reached confirmed.
Verified the order-scoped child token is in the Authorization header and neither it nor the base token is in the request URL.
Chromium completed allowed-origin preflight and signed report read against a local synthetic RPC.
Chromium could not read the report from a refused origin.

checks.environment: Source-only clone of the staged index; .grok carrier excluded; local preview, Chromium, watcher and synthetic RPC.
coverage: Playwright run-context setup confirmed the test-seam build and port.
Seeded vendor-view and buyer-view order scenarios both displayed confirmed from the actual local watcher v2 response.
Vendor-view scenario wrote a local receipt and pending signed kind-1059 outbox event.
Both scenarios verified one local RPC lookup, exact child-token Authorization header, no token query parameter, and browser preflight.

limits: The wallet RPC and transfer are synthetic; no real wallet daemon, chain transaction, or payment was used.
The operator smoke imports the actual watcher handler into an isolated runner; it is not a deployed service test.
Buyer-view and vendor-view cases use seeded history and the same fixture test identity in separate browser runs; they are not an exchange between independently authenticated accounts.
The vendor outbox event remains pending; no relay accepted it and no two-account delivery was exercised.
This milestone is not a commerce release decision.
